Chapter 7164: Arises From The Void

Chapter 7164: Arises From The Void

Originless shattered everyone’s concept of offensive power. Previously, they thought apex powers of the celestial immortals were the limit of cultivation.

This allowed immortals to challenge the high heaven. Today, Skykiller True Dragon, also known as Hidden Immortal, had combined two apex powers into Apex Beast, Royal Skykiller.

Moreover, Skykiller had just unleashed Originless, a maternal power exceeding his first move. This was foreign to the primordial immortals, as it didn’t originate from the dao or worldly energies.

This seemed to be older than their world. Skykiller somehow found it on top of using it so masterfully. Other celestial immortals would have died for trying to wield it since they didn’t have two special gifts allowing two apex powers.

Some immortals began wondering about the power of this strike versus the avatar’s slash back then.

“No one can stop this move outside of the high heaven.” One immortal said.

“The very origin is erased.” A golden immortal added.

As for Skykiller, there was still a question of doubt. If Li Qiye were still alive, that would be the end of the battle since Skykiller had nothing left.

After a long pause, Skykiller heaved a sigh of relief. Li Qiye, alive or otherwise, shouldn’t be able to return for a long time.

“You are the first to have such mastery over a maternal power.” A leisurely voice echoed.

Everyone experienced the same illusion - the world being turned upside down. There was a different side beyond their perception and on that side, Li Qiye was completely unharmed.

“Maternal power or not, you have only just begun walking in my domain.” Li Qiye said.

“Impossible!” Skykiller couldn’t stay calm.

“Should I be praising you or Skykiller?” Li Qiye said: “You are impressive for figuring out the nest while Skykiller learned how to fuse two gifts from long ago, giving insight into the truth of life.”

He paused and said: “If you two had walked alongside each other until the very end, you would have exceeded this current height, what a shame.”

Skykiller clenched the spear upon hearing this.

“Now it’s time for you to depart.” Li Qiye said.

“Show me your supreme arts then.” Skykiller didn’t wish to yield despite being aware of the odds.

“Just the heart alone is enough.” Li Qiye smiled.

“The heart.” Skykiller’s expression changed before being sent flying.

“What was that?!” Spectators saw nothing. Keep in mind that Skykiller was still blessed under the fusion state with the nest.

An apex-level move from a celestial immortal couldn’t have sent Skykiller flying.

“Maternal power! Beast Mastery!” Skykiller mustered all affinities stemming from Heavenrealm for protection.

“A true immortal still arises from the void.” Li Qiye sighed and grasped the air.

The words echoed and exploded in everyone’s mind. Both mortals and celestial immortals found these words etched in their mind for eternity.

They didn’t quite understand the meaning and and sense of insignificantness behind the statement. Nonetheless, they were elevated to the next height.

A true immortal was a non-existent level but it still came from the void. Was there anything beyond the void?

Even celestial immortals didn’t have an answer, nor had they ever pondered the issue.
